test.create_query: CREATE TABLE wide_to_float (wide Int128, mixed Int128, mixed_unsigned UInt128) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO wide_to_float SELECT w, if(intHash64(number + 2) % 2 = 0, w, n), toUInt128(if(intHash64(number + 2) % 2 = 0, abs(w), abs(n))) FROM ( SELECT number, bitShiftLeft(toInt128(intHash64(number) % 1000000 + 1), 64) * if(intHash64(number + 1) % 2 = 0, 1, -1) AS w, toInt128(intHash64(number + 3) % 1000000000) - 500000000 AS n FROM numbers(20000000) )
